calls.title: Demo Call with Claire Diepenbrock from Extra Space Storage
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Scott Keller demoed their enterprise A/B testing and feature flagging platform to Claire Diepenbrock (web optimization lead), Craig Kendall, and Drupad Khublani (engineering/data science) from Extra Space Storage. Key pain points included Optimizely's black-box metrics, high cost, and limited integration with their Azure/Databricks warehouse; GrowthBook's open-source, warehouse-native approach and visual editor were highlighted.
